extracted.intended_audience: AP wire editors, newspaper editors and general newspaper readers
extracted.subtask_description: A mid-20th-century Associated Press wire story reporting battlefield developments, prisoner/propaganda items, and conference news intended for placement in newspapers. Includes wire-production markers and dateline/byline conventions for editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Insert AP logotype in dateline
rubrics_metrics.description: (EDS: PLS INSERT AP LOGOTYPE IN DATELINE OF FOREGOING)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editor instruction appearing inline: requests that the AP logotype be inserted in the dateline of the preceding item.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dateline formatting with location, date, and (AP) source tag
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples in text: 'ALLIED HEADQUARTERS IN NORTH AFRICA, April 23.—(AP)'; 'ANKARA--FIRST ADD STUYVESANT...'; 'BOSTON, APRIL 22-(AP)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use location in uppercase (or standard dateline form), follow with comma and date, and append '(AP)' (or similar agency tag). The copy shows both em-dash and double-dash usages between dateline and story text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wire production / lead labels
rubrics_metrics.description: Inline labels such as 'FIRST ADD NIGHT LEAD REFUGEE CONFERENCE', 'SECOND NIGHT LEAD', 'THIRD GRAF FIRST NIGHT LEAD', 'UNDATED-SECOND ADD NIGHT LEAD UNDATED JAPANESE (ORIGINAL) X X X'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use lead/placement markers to indicate which paragraph is the night lead, first lead, second lead, or which additions/updates apply; these guide editors on which sentences to use as opening leads and where updates were inserted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Byline attribution style
rubrics_metrics.description: Byline examples: 'By The Associated Press', '—By the Associated Press', and parenthetical bylines like '(THE ACCOUNTS WERE WRITTEN BY SERGEANT EDWARD L. WHITE...)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute copy to the Associated Press or named correspondent; include correspondent/location or service-credit lines when provided.
